headline_marked: Jamaat leader [[DB arrests ex-MP Akhtaruzzaman]] over airport assault
headline: Jamaat leader DB arrests ex-MP Akhtaruzzaman over airport assault
summary: The retired Major was taken into custody following allegations of assault and disorder at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.
details: The Detective Branch (DB) of the police arrested Jamaat-e-Islami leader and former MP Major (retd) Akhtaruzzaman on Friday, October 2.
The arrest follows a case filed at the Airport Police Station by security officer Md. Shahriar Alam Sajeeb, citing various sections of the Penal Code.
According to the complaint, tension arose on October 1 when passengers from a flight arriving from Medina had delays in receiving their luggage.
Executive Director Group Captain S M Raghib Samad intervened to control the situation, but Akhtaruzzaman allegedly behaved obscenely and issued threats against him.
The former lawmaker is also accused of assaulting security supervisor Warrant Officer Mohammad Kamal Uddin after being stopped from filming in a restricted area.
Additional allegations include throwing away passengers' Zamzam water bottles and behaving aggressively toward a Biman Bangladesh Airlines representative.
Police stated that the investigation will proceed using CCTV footage, witness testimonies, and other collected evidence.
caption:
A former MP and Jamaat leader arrested after allegedly assaulting airport officials and throwing away passengers' Zamzam water.

The Detective Branch (DB) of the police arrested Jamaat-e-Islami leader and former MP Major (retd) Akhtaruzzaman on Friday, October 2.

The arrest follows a case filed at the Airport Police Station by security officer Md. Shahriar Alam Sajeeb, citing various sections of the Penal Code.

According to the complaint, tension arose on October 1 when passengers from a flight arriving from Medina had delays in receiving their luggage.

Executive Director Group Captain S M Raghib Samad intervened to control the situation, but Akhtaruzzaman allegedly behaved obscenely and issued threats against him.

The former lawmaker is also accused of assaulting security supervisor Warrant Officer Mohammad Kamal Uddin after being stopped from filming in a restricted area.

Additional allegations include throwing away passengers' Zamzam water bottles and behaving aggressively toward a Biman Bangladesh Airlines representative.

Police stated that the investigation will proceed using CCTV footage, witness testimonies, and other collected evidence.

headline_marked: 7 killed in [[head-on collision between bus and autorickshaw]] in Mymensingh
headline: 7 killed in head-on collision between bus and autorickshaw in Mymensingh
summary: The victims include a child, his mother, grandfather, and great-grandmother, following a devastating crash on October 2.
details: Seven people were killed in a head-on collision between a passenger bus and a CNG-powered autorickshaw in Mymensingh on October 2.
The victims include a child, his mother, grandfather, and great-grandmother, highlighting the tragic loss of multiple generations of a single family.
The accident occurred during the afternoon, leaving the autorickshaw completely crushed by the impact of the larger vehicle.
Local residents and witnesses gathered at the scene, with some reporting that they saw survivors moving inside the wreckage immediately after the crash.
Police and emergency services responded to the scene to manage the traffic and recover the victims.
caption:
A child, his mother, grandfather, and great-grandmother—all gone in a single crash.

Seven people were killed in a head-on collision between a passenger bus and a CNG-powered autorickshaw in Mymensingh on October 2.

The victims include a child, his mother, grandfather, and great-grandmother, highlighting the tragic loss of multiple generations of a single family.

The accident occurred during the afternoon, leaving the autorickshaw completely crushed by the impact of the larger vehicle.

Local residents and witnesses gathered at the scene, with some reporting that they saw survivors moving inside the wreckage immediately after the crash.

Police and emergency services responded to the scene to manage the traffic and recover the victims.
